title: supported integral residue sequence
statement: For a closed immersion i:D→T of schemes and n>0, the maps n:i_*Z_D→i_*Z_D and the normalized integral generator i_*Z_D→forget(i_*(ULift(Z/n))_D) form a short exact sequence of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: The constant integer-to-residue sequence is exact: sheafification is exact and the elementary integer sequence has kernel nZ. A closed immersion is finite, so its etale direct image is exact. Apply this direct image to the constant sequence. The constant-sections adjunction identifies its quotient map with the published integral generator. Positivity ensures multiplication by n is monic, including n=1.

theorem supported_integral_residue_sequence {D T : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ w : (n • 𝟙 ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj
        (supportedIntegralConstant D))) ≫
      supportedIntegralGenerator (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)) i = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk _ _ w).ShortExact
